summary: Moving the coordinate e*_a of a witness keeps the open conditions.

steps.lean:
isOpen_iff_forall_mem_open.2 fun _ ⟨w, _⟩ ↦ ⟨ofPred _, fun _ ↦ (⟨_, ⟨·, by grind⟩,
  update_self _ _ w⟩), by apply_rules [IsOpen.and, F.ball_spec.1.preimage] <;> fun_prop, by aesop⟩
steps.claim: Given c ∈ floorValues(F, a, x, y) with witness w, the points (x', y', c') with c' the e*_a-coordinate of w updated to c' satisfy the defining conditions on an open set (𝔅_F is open, the maps involved are continuous); so every point has an open neighbourhood inside the set.
